module_summary: Sequential 8-bit shift-add multiplier: a 16-cycle counter scans multiplier bits, accumulating the left-shifting multiplicand into product p, then raises rdy.

anchors.name: p
anchors.why: Product accumulator; adds shifted multiplicand when current multiplier bit is one

anchors.name: ctr
anchors.why: Iteration counter 0..16 selecting multiplier bit and gating shift/accumulate and rdy

anchors.name: rdy
anchors.why: Done flag set when counter reaches 16, signals product valid

anchors.name: multiplicand
anchors.why: Sign-extended operand b, left-shifted each cycle as partial-product source

anchors.name: multiplier
anchors.why: Sign-extended operand a; indexed bit enables accumulation into p

groups.name: control
groups.description: Iteration counter and completion flag sequencing the 16 shift-add steps

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Operand registers, shifting multiplicand and product accumulator
